messages:
tess: quick note from this morning's muon11b int6 canary. two actionable things: batching defaults & max_new_tokens interact badly with long-code contexts -> mem churn + higher regen.

ari: numbers?

tess: short summary: p50 down ~12% at batch=8, but long-code QA F1 -3% when prompt_len>1500 and max_new_tokens=512. steady-state slab_churn up ~9% after 40m, occasional 503s.

mira: interesting. did you try dynamic max_new_tokens tied to prompt length?

tess: yes. heuristic used: cap = min(512, max(64, floor(prompt_len*0.4))). that recovered ~2% F1 and cut slab_churn ~4%.

ops-bot: observed OOM spikes at batch>=14 for hybrid-int6, none for int4.

ari: proposal: default batch_size=8, per-route override based on average prompt_len. add canary flag kv_prewarm=128 to reduce slab growth. also add canary alert: if OOM_rate>0.4% in 10m route to int4.

mira: +1. also add a small eval gate: run 300 long-code QA prompts each hour; if F1 drop>1% fail canary.

tess: implementing runtime flag and perf-bot job now. will post PR and perf link when ready.

eng-ml-bot: job queued: muon-canary-8050000000-01 ETA 30m :hourglass:
